description: The next evolution of the legendary Battleship Frame. We are proud to finally release the TOMORROW frame. Built on the classic Battleship hydroformed silhouette and responsive street geometry, the TOMORROW frame is a glimpse into the future of BMX frame deisgn and is built around the introduction of our new 14mm Thru-Axle (TA) hub system which is now offered on éclat. The frame uses a unique 8mm thick investment cast dropout with a closed 14mm slot for Thru-Axle (TA) hubs and female axle hubs. Thru-Axle (TA) hubs allow for a superior and stronger axle, overall stiffer wheel as well as a total ease of installation and removal. No more breaking your chain, bending your axle, or pinching your dropout. This superior and already industry proven system is in our eyes - the future of BMX design. Enjoy the benefits of a premier Wethepeople street frame and the future of Thru-Axle technology with the Wethepeople TOMORROW frame. Includes lifetime guarantee.
